tools.name: get_case_study_details
tools.description: Get a markdown summary of a public case study by slug, including its canonical detail URL. Returns up to 12000 characters of markdown.

tools.name: get_role_details
tools.description: Get details for a currently open role, including description sections and application URL.

roleId.description: The role identifier returned by list_open_roles.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: List public Edenspiekermann case studies, optionally filtered by query, industry, or service, with cursor-based pagination.

query.description: Free-text search across title, subtitle, slug, industries, and services.

industry.description: Filter case studies by industry name.

service.description: Filter case studies by service name.

limit.description: Maximum number of case studies to return per page. Defaults to 10.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous list_case_studies call.

tools.name: list_open_roles
tools.description: List the currently open roles published on edenspiekermann.com.

tools.name: list_taxonomies
tools.description: List the currently discoverable industries and services used to categorize public Edenspiekermann case studies.

tools.name: start_job_application
tools.description: Open the application page for a currently open role without submitting the application.

roleId.description: The role identifier returned by list_open_roles.

tools.name: submit_contact_inquiry
tools.description: Validate an inquiry with dryRun=true, or submit a real contact inquiry to Edenspiekermann. Real submission requires explicit user intent. Optional clientRequestId enables best-effort retry deduplication for up to 24 hours.

challenge.description: The inquiry message or project challenge to send.

dryRun.description: Validate the inquiry and return a preview without sending it.

clientRequestId.description: Optional best-effort idempotency key to deduplicate retries for up to 24 hours.
